newsitem.title: FRANCE: France, Georgia sign cooperation accords.
newsitem.headline: France, Georgia sign cooperation accords.

text.p: France and Georgia signed a series of cooperation agreements during an official visit by Georgian President Eduard Shevardnadze, a foreign ministry spokesman said on Tuesday.

The spokesman said the accords, signed by Shevardnadze and French Foreign Minister Herve de Charette, covered the training of Georgian military officers in France as well as cultural, scientific and technical exchanges.
Other accords dealt with transport, agriculture and rural development. Details were not immediately available.
Shevardnadze met French business leaders on Wednesday.

He said after talks with President Jacques Chirac on Monday that Georgia, who signed a partnership accord with the European Union last year, was moving towards the EU but had no plans to apply for NATO membership.
The Georgian leader will wind up his three-day visit on Wednesday with a trip to the French military academy.
